featured_reviews.review_text: Ordered peri peri nachos, which were good in taste, but the sauce quantity was too much. After some time, the nachos became soggy. The corn cheese pizza was not good and did not meet expectations. The Blue Lagoon mocktail, however, was refreshing and tasted good. The place also needs better cleaning and maintenance.

featured_reviews.name: Noel Nadar
featured_reviews.review_text: I got to know about this place via Instagram reels. The reels fascinated me to go visit this place and try their food. It's located in Malad East, just opposite the Gol Garden at a walkable distance from the station. Undoubtedly it's a cool place with an unmatchable vibe, those walls stuck with posters, popular memes, song names etc etc. There are even books to read. There are high chairs to sit on as well as comfortable cushions to relax and have your food. The place is small and not very suitable for a large group of friends maybe. I was shocked to know that it's open till 3 am in the night! I've never known cafes being open till that late post midnight. The owner was friendly. The mocktails tasted okay. The entire menu is vegetarian and mostly jain. The music playing in the background was good. The hot coffee was really good. If you're a vegetarian foodie then you could visit this place someday and feel a little nostalgic looking at the walls. It'd call it a good hangout spot to visit with friends.

featured_reviews.review_text: Dream House in Malad is LITERALLY one of the best cafes out there! 🍰✨ And the BIGGEST highlight? They serve ALL Jain food 💖! Like, even the bread is Jain, so if you're into Jain cuisine or looking for options that fit those dietary preferences, Dream House has GOT you 🙌. The ambience? TEN OUT OF TEN 💯! It's got full-on aesthetic vibes 🌟, making it the perfect spot to chill, hang out with friends, or maybe even a date night 🌙. Honestly, calling it one of the best restaurants is an UNDERSTATEMENT 😍 - it's THE BEST 💥. If you're in Malad , you NEED to check out Dream House. Trust me, you won't regret it.

featured_reviews.name: Asmita Rawal

featured_reviews.name: Mehta Dimple
featured_reviews.review_text:
🌟 Dreamhouse Café – A Hidden Gem in Malad East! 🌟
📍 Near Gol Garden, Malad East

Visited this cozy little café recently and I’m still drooling over the taste! We tried Bubble Gum Mocktail, Mexican Nachos, Basil on the Rocks Pasta, Classic Veg Cheese Burger, Peri Peri Spicy Paneer Pizza, Jangal Me Mangal Panini, and their Brownie Milkshake – and let me tell you, every single item was bursting with flavor! 😍

The quality and taste are simply outstanding. The owner is extremely warm and welcoming, and the place is spotless clean.

Now coming to the ambience – it’s a walk down memory lane! Pure Bollywood + Old-school nostalgia vibes. You’ll spot vintage items like an old telephone, filmy posters, and so many quirky details. It’s hard to explain in words – you’ve got to visit and feel it for yourself. 💫

Though the café is small, they’ve managed the space so smartly that you don’t feel cramped at all. The ambience is unique, and it makes you want to just sit back and relax for hours.

And guess what? It’s a 100% Jain café! But honestly, even if you’re not Jain, the taste is so amazing that you won’t miss anything. It’s perfect for all foodies.

💰 Pricing is very reasonable for the quality and experience you get.

⭐ Final Verdict: 5/5 stars from me!
If you’re in or around Malad, this place is a must-visit. Great food, great vibes, and a heartwarming experience overall!

featured_reviews.review_text: This place is one of the best places to hangout or go on casual coffee dates with friends. It's located in Sundar Lane, near St. Anne's High School. There are card games and books kept on the shelves to read while you spend time here. Cold coffee is available here after 10 pm at a discounted price! It was great. One negative point would be about the cleanliness, the table that we sat on was not cleaned/dusted, it had crumbs dropped which were sticking to our hands and clothes when we kept out hands on the table. It's a good place to visit for having coffee with your friends. One of the best places to go on dates.

Daromas Cafe in Malad West offers a charming and aesthetic ambiance, making it an ideal spot for hanging out with friends or a special someone. The cafe's vibe is enhanced by the availability of Uno card games, adding a playful touch to your visit.

The coffee here is both refreshing and delicious, and the cake presentation is impressive, complementing its perfect taste. The ice latte is a standout, enjoyed by all, while the green tea and cranberry green tea are also recommended.

The tandoori fried momos, though good, didn't quite stand out, and the siricha bowl was tasty but not exceptional. However, the brownie was a highlight—mouthwateringly perfect.

Overall, if you find yourself in Malad, Daromas Cafe is a fantastic place to relax and enjoy a variety of treats with friends or family.

featured_reviews.name: Raj Patil
featured_reviews.review_text:
Went to Third Wave Coffee recently and it was a really good experience. They have a buy one get one free offer on Wednesdays, which is honestly a great deal and makes it worth planning a visit mid-week.

I tried the chocolate frappe and it was genuinely impressive. The texture was smooth and nicely thick, not icy or watered down like it sometimes is at other places. The chocolate flavor was rich without being too sweet, so it didn’t feel heavy even after a few sips.

What stood out the most was the quality. It just tasted better than what you usually get at bigger chains like Starbucks. It didn’t feel overly processed or rushed. There was more depth in the flavor, and you could tell a bit more care had gone into making it.

The place itself is also quite nice to sit in. It has a relaxed vibe, good for catching up with someone or just sitting with your drink for a while. Not too noisy, not too dull either.

Overall, really liked it. The Wednesday offer is a nice bonus, and the chocolate frappe alone makes it worth going back.

featured_reviews.name: Faaiq Faisal Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Third Wave Coffee is a fantastic spot for anyone who truly appreciates a good cup of coffee. The ambiance is modern and inviting, making it perfect for both quick catch-ups and longer work sessions. Their menu offers a great variety, from classic brews to more experimental flavors, and the quality is consistently impressive.

What made my visit especially memorable was Priyanka, one of their baristas. She was incredibly friendly, attentive, and clearly passionate about coffee. She took the time to understand my preferences and recommended a drink that turned out to be absolutely perfect. You can tell she puts real care into every cup she prepares.

The service overall was smooth and efficient, even during a busy period, and the staff maintained a welcoming vibe throughout. Thanks to Priyanka’s excellent service and the café’s commitment to quality, Third Wave Coffee definitely stands out as a go-to place for coffee lovers.

featured_reviews.name: Rakesh Dudhat
featured_reviews.review_text: Had a really great experience at Third Wave Coffee today! The service by Bhumika was warm, attentive, and genuinely welcoming. Also tried their banana - walnut cake and signature filter coffee and it was absolutely amazing — rich, smooth, and perfectly brewed. Definitely one of the best café experiences I’ve had recently. Highly recommended!

The coffee options are great, but the quality & taste of food has been steadily going down.

Don't miss the Vietnamese Cold Coffee which is really good. We tried and liked the Affogato too.

Food sadly used to be good. The parmesan cheese toast was good, everything else we had was below average.

The service is unpredictable. Some of the staff are really nice & well trained, some have quite a lazy attitude towards work.

Overall a good place to have coffee & get some work done. Go someplace else if you're hungry though.

featured_reviews.name: Mukund Shinde
featured_reviews.review_text:
Feels I am late to this amazing place rather.

The Burrow Cafe, feels a little ill maintained. Don’t get me wrong, the place is still decent but could have been much better with proper care and basic maintenance.

It has a really good outdoor seating with quiet locality. The staff is generous and kind.

We had ordered some chicken strips which were amazing. The potato wedges were average, without any crisp and overly seasoned. Rather, the drinks, lemon ice tea & pink ice tea were super.

featured_reviews.name: Shubhkumar Shah
featured_reviews.review_text: 🥤✨ The thick shake was perfectly thick and creamy, just the way it should be! 😍 The taste was amazing, rich, and delicious. 😋 Definitely a refreshing and satisfying treat. 👍❤️

featured_reviews.name: skvd
featured_reviews.review_text: Tried some fries here. Expecting almost nothing? Oh. My. God. The flavors hit on point, the cheese sauce feels cheesy enough to the point where it's hugging you, basically. 10/10. Portions are amazing, and if you want something heavy but light, this is the place for you. Would recommend if you're looking for some nice desserts or something savory.

featured_reviews.name: Sakshi Kamble
featured_reviews.review_text: I'm hooked on JJ Desserts & Fries in Malad! I tried their G.O.A.T fries on my first visit and they were amazing. The ingredients were super fresh, especially the jalapeno slices. I knew right away I'd be coming back. The prices are reasonable, and the fries are exactly what I crave. What impressed me most was the perfect balance of flavors and textures. Nothing was overpowering, the cheese, spices, and crispiness were all just right. I hate when fries are too greasy or salty, but JJ Fries nailed it. If you're in Malad, give JJ Desserts & Fries a shot. You won't regret it!

featured_reviews.name: Mitesh Mandaliya
featured_reviews.review_text: JJ Desserts offers a delightful array of treats, but their waffles, mini pancakes, and cheese French fries are standout stars. The waffles are perfectly crisp on the outside yet fluffy on the inside, while the mini pancakes are irresistibly cute and delicious. The cheese French fries are a savory delight, combining the comforting flavors of cheese and potatoes in every bite. Whether you're craving something sweet or savory, JJ Desserts has you covered with their delectable offerings.

featured_reviews.name: Manav Tejura
featured_reviews.review_text:
Absolutely loved JJ Desserts! Their cheesecakes are hands down the best in Mumbai—rich, creamy, and perfectly balanced in sweetness.

Every bite tastes freshly made, and you can tell they use top-quality ingredients. The bakery itself is inviting, and the staff are always friendly and helpful.

If you're a cheesecake lover or just have a sweet tooth, JJ Desserts is a must-visit. Highly recommended for anyone looking for the best desserts in the city!
